stageSemantics.candidateRecallDenominator: uniquely-mappable confirmed positive target occurrences, joined by snapshotId+repoId source facts
stageSemantics.zeroCandidateAndSetSizeDenominator: all confirmed eligible sites, including unscorable targets and rows without call-shape evidence
stageSemantics.rawCandidateKeys: exact keys emitted by candidate generation before mapping; not interchangeable with mapped target IDs
stageSemantics.proposalStages: exact target-key sequences captured from the production filter path; ambiguous/unmapped keys remain counted but cannot cover a gold target
stageSemantics.sizeQuantileConvention: nearest-rank ceil(p*n)-1, over all confirmed eligible sites; candidateKeySize counts keys and uniqueMappedTargetSize counts unique IDs
